title: Plant Manager
text:
Location:

Whitsett, NC, US, 27377

Business Unit: Bison

Posting Date: Nov 19, 2026

Job Description:

As the **Plant Manager**, you will lead all aspects of plant operations with full accountability for safety, quality, delivery and cost. You will be responsible for driving operational performance and continuous improvement while aligning plant execution with business unit strategy, growth objectives, and customer expectations. This role is critical in evolving the facility into a machining-focused center of excellence, requiring strong technical expertise in machining processes, specifically gear manufacturing, and operational leadership in a high-performance manufacturing environment. You will also be responsible for building and developing a high-performing leadership team and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and operational excellence.
 
 
**What you will do:**

* Lead daily plant operations to meet production, delivery, and financial targets while optimizing capacity, efficiency, and cost performance
* Champion a safety-first culture, ensuring compliance with all regulatory requirements and company standards
* Drive quality performance and continuous improvement to consistently meet or exceed customer expectations
* Own plant financial performance, including cost control, budgeting, and capital investments
* Partner with supply chain, engineering, and commercial teams to align production plans with demand and business priorities
* Oversee maintenance, facilities, and capital planning to ensure reliability, uptime, and long-term operational capability
* Lead labor relations and employee engagement efforts, fostering a positive, high-performance work environment
* Develop and execute operational strategies that improve productivity, reduce waste, and strengthen overall plant performance
* Build and develop leadership talent, with a strong focus on succession planning and team capability
* Represent the organization with customers, community stakeholders, and key partners as needed

**Leadership & Team Scope**
 
Lead a cross-functional team across operations, quality, maintenance, engineering, supply chain, finance, and HR. Provide direction, coaching, and development to ensure strong execution and alignment with company goals.
 
 
**We are looking for:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or related field
* 7–10+ years of progressive manufacturing experience, including plant or operations leadership
* Strong hands-on experience with machining operations (i.e. CNC, gear hobbing, process optimization)
* Proven success driving operational performance in safety, quality, delivery, and cost
* Experience implementing Lean / continuous improvement methodologies
* Strong financial acumen, with experience managing budgets and plant-level performance
* Demonstrated ability to lead, develop, and engage high-performing teams
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Data-driven decision maker with strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
* Demonstrated ability and willingness to use AI tools to improve productivity, decision-marking, work quality, and to reduce costs. The successful candidate must be able to identify appropriate AI use cases and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel required)
